description: This Swift source file defines a Widget for iOS using WidgetKit and ActivityKit. It creates a live activity widget called 'OpenClawLiveActivity' that displays real-time status information related to the 'OpenClaw' activity, including dynamic island regions and lock screen views with various status indicators and controls.

classes.name: OpenClawLiveActivity
classes.description: A Widget class that defines the live activity widget for the OpenClaw application, supporting dynamic island and lock screen UI components.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the widget configuration, layout for lock screen, dynamic island, and compact views.

methods.name: lockScreenView
methods.description: Builds the lock screen view showing status dot, title, status text, and trailing view according to activity state.

methods.name: trailingView
methods.description: Builds the trailing view in the widget, showing progress or status icon based on activity state.

methods.name: statusDot
methods.description: Returns a colored circle indicating current activity status.

methods.name: dotColor
methods.description: Determines the color of the status dot based on the activity state.
